races.name: Racing To School Reaches 25 Years Juvenile Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SACRE CHEF sets a high standard and can get off the mark. Hurdling newcomer Magical Merlot looks most interesting of the remainder.

  1. SACRE CHEF (FR)
  2. MAGICAL MERLOT
  3. POETRY OF TIME

races.name: Jumps Look Better On Racing TV Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
MOMENTS AWAY matched the form of his hurdling debut second despite seeming to find the emphasis on speed against him when fifth in what was a stronger affair at Newbury (2m) 2 weeks ago. The return to further looks firmly in his favour and Martin Keighley's charge looks the way to go with the prospect of more to come. I've Got A Friend has made a very bright start to his career and rates next best over penalised Nightflyer.

  1. MOMENTS AWAY (IRE)
  2. I'VE GOT A FRIEND (IRE)
  3. NIGHTFLYER (GER)

races.name: Weatherbys & Birdie Calendars Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
INEDIT D'AMOUR has encouragingly got back on track returned to chasing this autumn and again confirmed himself on a competitive mark when finding only one too good at Bangor (17f) 24 days ago. A winner over hurdles at this venue, he's selected to confirm recent promise back over this longer trip. Gaelic Rambler will appreciate the return to larger obstacles, whilst Legendary Luke is surely capable of better than he showed on return/chase debut at Ffos Las.

  1. INEDIT D'AMOUR (FR)
  2. GAELIC RAMBLER (IRE)
  3. LEGENDARY LUKE (IRE)

races.name: Support The Injured Jockeys Fund Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
JETEYE has been well placed by the shrewd Sam England team and can notch a sixth success of the year. The main danger looks to be Crafty Gael, who arrives in similarly rude health, while Speed Davis may prove best of the rest under a promising claimer.

  1. JETEYE (IRE)
  2. CRAFTY GAEL (IRE)
  3. SPEED DAVIS (FR)

races.name: Jodie Standing's Point-To-Point Recruits Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PADDY O'MAHLER enjoyed a fine first season over fences and is given another chance following his comeback run. The remainder hardly look a rock-solid bunch, Some Scope perhaps most interesting with Brian Hughes taking over.

  1. PADDY O'MAHLER (IRE)
  2. SOME SCOPE
  3. MELTON MOSSY (IRE)

races.name: racingtv.com/freetrial Female Jockeys' Handicap Chase
races.verdict:
ILLOGICAL LOGIC is certain to benefit from this step back up in trip and David Thompson's gelding can notch a third win for the yard. I See The Sea scored over this trip from a higher mark on the card last year, so is also worth considering, whilst Anytrixwilldo would be of some interest if able to back up his recent Huntingdon success.

  1. ILLOGICAL LOGIC (FR)
  2. I SEE THE SEA (IRE)
  3. ANYTRIXWILLDO (IRE)

races.name: Racing Again 2nd December Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
SLAINTE MO CHARA has an eye-catching pedigree and could prove up to making a winning debut, particularly with top rider Danny McMenamin booked. La Dame Ecarlate is narrowly preferred of those with experience.

  1. SLAINTE MO CHARA (IRE)
  2. LA DAME ECARLATE
  3. RESCHEDULED

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CRYSTAL ISLAND marked himself down as potentially smart when winning each of his 2 starts in novice hurdles last season (including here) and every inch an exciting prospect now his attentions switch to larger obstacles, he makes plenty of appeal. Fellow point winner Gee Force Flyer went the right way in 5 starts over hurdles himself last season and may well offer up chief resistance.

  1. CRYSTAL ISLAND (IRE)
  2. GEE FORCE FLYER (IRE)
  3. ETNA BIANCO (IRE)

races.name: Ascot Promoting Safer Gambling Week 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
CURRENT EDITION suffered a second narrow reverse from 3 starts over hurdles at Huntingdon 23 days ago, the steadily-run nature of the race not bringing his stamina sufficiently into play. He clearly has a race like this within his grasp and edges preference over No Way Jay, who clearly benefited from the return to a right-handed track when second on hurdles debut here last month. Diamonds And Denim and Jet Bay are a couple of interesting hurdling newcomers to note, too.

  1. CURRENT EDITION (IRE)
  2. NO WAY JAY (IRE)
  3. DIAMONDS AND DENIM (IRE)

races.name: Bet With Ascot Donation Box Winners 'Introductory' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
PUSH THE LIMIT failed to land the odds on his hurdles debut but Dan Skelton's 4-y-o should prove capable of much better given his smart Flat form. Spanish Stroll showed a good turn of foot when scoring on his hurdles bow and is most feared, whilst Without Burlington made a good impression at Worcester in the summer and also merits consideration after a break.

  1. PUSH THE LIMIT (FR)
  2. SPANISH STROLL
  3. WITHOUT BURLINGTON

races.name: Join Ladbrokes Bet 5 Pound Get 30 Pound Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
JET TO VEGAS pulled clear with an unexposed rival here 3 weeks ago and the Russell & Scudamore-trained gelding can continue his run of good form to score for the second time this autumn. Crebilly has proved most reliable this season and has to be respected after a small rise for his Wetherby win, while Somespring Special should be all the better for her recent outing.

  1. JET TO VEGAS (IRE)
  2. CREBILLY (IRE)
  3. SOMESPRING SPECIAL (IRE)

races.name: Ascot Shared Ownership Weekend Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
MOVEIT LIKE MINNIE ran a cracker when third in a better race over C&D last time, finishing ahead of 3 of today's rivals, and he gets the nod in a tricky handicap. Recent Newton Abbot winner Intellotto is a serious danger if repeating that effort, with Ooh Betty potentially interesting back in calmer waters.

  1. MOVEIT LIKE MINNIE (IRE)
  2. INTELLOTTO (IRE)
  3. OOH BETTY (IRE)

races.name: Ladbrokes 'Get Your Free Racing Bet Today' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
FEVER DREAM and Gasmani appeal most, with Christian Williams' charge fancied to make it 3 wins from his last 5 starts over fences. Muskoka and Ideal Des Bordes both come with risks attached, so likely improver Draco Malfoy gets the nod as best of the rest.

  1. FEVER DREAM (IRE)
  2. GASMANI (IRE)
  3. DRACO MALFOY (IRE)

races.name: Bet Responsibly With Ladbrokes Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
POWER STEERING made a promising start when just failing in a Ballinrobe bumper for Sean Thomas Doyle in May and seems sure to improve having been purchased by shrewd connections for a 6-figure sum. He's preferred to standard-setter Dennis's Honor, who ran to a good level when second at Cheltenham last month but perhaps benefited a little from how the race unfolded. Bielle Biarrey still held every chance when falling on his sole outing in Irish points and is an interesting Rules newcomer.

  1. POWER STEERING (IRE)
  2. DENNIS'S HONOR
  3. BIELLE BIARREY (FR)

races.name: Why Bet Elsewhere, David Lucas Bookmakers Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
The betting will undoubtedly prove informative but MOMENTS IN TIME showed plenty when twice finishing fourth in bumpers last season and, following a subsequent breathing operation, looks very interesting now hurdling over a trip that should suit. Course bumper winner Bande Organisee is another of firm interest, with Exeter scorer All About Trev and Kimai 2 others entering the reckoning.

  1. MOMENTS IN TIME (IRE)
  2. BANDE ORGANISEE (FR)
  3. ALL ABOUT TREV (IRE)

races.name: Guaranteed Odds At David Lucas Bookmakers Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
SEA THE DAY impressed with his attitude when seeing off a point winner in a C&D bumper on his debut last November before finishing mid-field in a strong race at Ascot, and rates another fine hurdling prospect for his top yard. Common Sense showed plenty under an enterprising ride on his first start over hurdles at Ffos Las recently and is sure to pose a big threat if brushing up his jumping, while Herbies Sock and Passage Guenot are others to consider.

  1. SEA THE DAY (IRE)
  2. COMMON SENSE (IRE)
  3. HERBIES SOCK (IRE)

races.name: McCarthy Construction Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
A progressive winner in bumpers, OLD HABITS shaped encouragingly starting out over hurdles when third at Perth 5 weeks ago and, with this stiffer track promising to play to his strengths, he could well take full advantage of the weight he receives from fellow useful prospect Hidden Mountain, who was impressive at Worcester 3 weeks ago. Point winner's Moltezuma and Justoneglance are others to note.

  1. OLD HABITS (IRE)
  2. HIDDEN MOUNTAIN
  3. MOLTEZUMA (IRE)

races.name: Treble Odds L15s At David Lucas Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
Not the easiest race to get a handle on but last year's winner BEN SOLO has yet to run a bad race here and with his Ffos Las reappearance under his belt, he could be the answer with his yard having made a bright start to the campaign. There are several interesting chase debutants in opposition, though, with Largy Go, Wilstar and Quay Item respected before market clues. Sogna In Grande is another to note.

  1. BEN SOLO (IRE)
  2. LARGY GO (IRE)
  3. WILSTAR (IRE)

races.name: Albert Bartlett Triple Crown Series Handicap Hurdle (Qualifier)
races.verdict:
LEJO DU SEUIL shaped well in a stronger race than this last time and makes plenty of appeal with the addition of Bowen in the saddle. Handicap newcomers Majeur Allen and Crystal Orchard complete the shortlist.

  1. LEJO DU SEUIL (FR)
  2. MAJEUR ALLEN (FR)
  3. CRYSTAL ORCHARD (IRE)

races.name: Happy 80th Birthday Pamela Hall Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
There were more encouraging signs from PATRIOTIK on chasing debut last time, and he's fancied to capitalise on a very attractive mark. Hat-trick-seeking Gingerbred looks the obvious danger, with Better Off Alone, Jongleur D'Etoiles and The Long Point also appealing in a competitive race for the grade.

  1. PATRIOTIK (FR)
  2. GINGERBRED
  3. BETTER OFF ALONE (IRE)

races.name: David Lucas Best Prices Welsh Sport Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict:
NORTHWEST PASSAGE was most impressive when winning at Southwell last week and can defy a penalty at the chief expense of Jollie Dame, who took a step forward herself when making a successful handicap debut at Worcester. Best Trump can complete the 1-2-3.

  1. NORTHWEST PASSAGE
  2. JOLLIE DAME
  3. BEST TRUMP (IRE)

races.name: Free 5 Pound Bet At David Lucas Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
This may concern well-related pair HURRICANE MICK and Lord Max. Dan Skelton's gets the nod having won a solid-looking Irish point, with Perth bumper runner-up Killygowan perhaps best of the rest.

  1. HURRICANE MICK (IRE)
  2. LORD MAX (IRE)
  3. KILLYGOWAN (IRE)

races.name: All Weather Championship Is Back Amateur Jockeys' Handicap
races.verdict:
BOOK OF LIFE is much more reliable than most at this level and if they go hard, these could be the ideal circumstances for him to end a losing run having looked unlucky a few times lately. Wrist Art often goes well in this type of event and King David is very well treated now so needs respecting.

  1. BOOK OF LIFE
  2. WRIST ART (IRE)
  3. KING DAVID (IRE)

races.name: Midnite: Built For 2026 Not 2006 Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
races.verdict:
OLIAKU has gone off at short odds both starts to date and was clearly thought a bit better than this grade so she's worth chancing to strip a lot fitter for recent comeback in a race where others have plenty to prove, too. Frantic has the form to win here but lacked gears over this trip last time and needs to prove herself quick enough.

  1. OLIAKU
  2. FRANTIC
  3. BUTTERFLY BEACH (IRE)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
races.verdict:
LADY PHILLIPS wasn't able to build on her debut promise when runner-up at Bath late last month, though softer ground may have been against her so she remains with potential now switched to all-weather. The daughter of Night of Thunder is the pick ahead of Noble Light, who can step forward from her first run, while Rose Deer is a newcomer to note.

  1. LADY PHILLIPS
  2. NOBLE LIGHT
  3. ROSE DEER (IRE)

races.name: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March Maiden Fillies' Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 2)
races.verdict:
This can go the way of the choicely-bred ZHURI, who is taken to build on the promise of her debut at the second attempt given a longer break ahead of this race. The biggest threat could come from the only newcomer in the line-up, El Kahlaa catching the eye on paper, with Fifth Amendment completing the shortlist.

  1. ZHURI
  2. EL KAHLAA
  3. FIFTH AMENDMENT (IRE)

races.name: AWC Season 14 Selling Handicap
races.verdict:
KALAMUNDA was an unlucky loser last time and can make amends from the same mark to end a lengthy losing run. Tonal looks sure to go close again, while the in-form Gunfighter is another to consider.

  1. KALAMUNDA
  2. TONAL (FR)
  3. GUNFIGHTER (IRE)

races.name: AWC Trials Day - Lingfield 2nd January 2027 Nursery
races.verdict:
The in-form pair of PRINTING MONEY and Perfect Hope look the ones to concentrate on, with the former getting the nod. Beechwood Glory appeals as the most interesting of the rest.

  1. PRINTING MONEY (IRE)
  2. PERFECT HOPE
  3. BEECHWOOD GLORY (IRE)

races.name: All Weather Championship Handicap
races.verdict:
SECRET SANTA hasn't stood much racing to date but the form of his winning reappearance back in May makes him very hard to overlook in this race so he's taken to cope with the step up in trip and absence. Asuka is fit and firing so looks sure to give his running and be bang there, while Rogue Messiah is well worth this try in headgear and needs keeping an eye on.

  1. SECRET SANTA (IRE)
  2. ASUKA
  3. ROGUE MESSIAH (IRE)

races.name: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap
races.verdict:
OUR PLANET has found things tough so far this season, but he shaped better than the result at this course on his latest outing and could well revive for a switch of stables. From his much reduced mark, he gets the vote ahead of Barry The Worm who isn't taken lightly at this venue, with Love Alive also considered.

  1. OUR PLANET (IRE)
  2. BARRY THE WORM
  3. LOVE ALIVE

races.name: Midnite Built Different Handicap
races.verdict:
SAN JUANITO finally capitalised on a much reduced mark last time and can overcome a 4 lb raise to double up. There are several other well-treated sorts in here, with Sant Alessio and Urban Road both appealing as the main dangers to the selection.

  1. SAN JUANITO
  2. SANT ALESSIO (IRE)
  3. URBAN ROAD

races.name: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
PREMIER VIEW has made a promising start to his career and is taken to make a quick return to winning ways. Space Dreamer has to be respected on what she's shown to date, while the steadily progressive Invincible Irish is entitled to be in the mix despite racing from just out of the handicap.

  1. PREMIER VIEW (IRE)
  2. SPACE DREAMER (IRE)
  3. INVINCIBLE IRISH (IRE)

races.name: Now Racing Every Wednesday At Dundalk Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
SURPASS AND SHINE had plenty in hand when landing a gamble over C&D 28 days ago, on just his second polytrack start and can follow up despite a 10 lb rise. Steel Magnolia returns to 6f after recent 5f runs and ran better when sixth here 21 days ago, so is feared most, while El Fontenaro bounced back to form when third here 16 days ago and should be involved.

  1. SURPASS AND SHINE (IRE)
  2. STEEL MAGNOLIA (IRE)
  3. EL FONTENARO (IRE)

races.name: Dundalk Stadium Nursery Handicap
races.verdict:
CLOSEFIELD BEAU made his second start on all-weather a winning one over C&D earlier this month and, having been tried over 1m since, he is taken to resume his progress and double his tally. Prince of Peppard arrives in good form and is feared most, ahead of nursery debutant Bull Shark.

  1. CLOSEFIELD BEAU (IRE)
  2. PRINCE OF PEPPARD (IRE)
  3. BULL SHARK (IRE)

races.name: BAR 1 Betting 'Safer Gambling Week' Rated Race
races.verdict:
CITY HOUSE arrives after several good efforts at this track and looks the pick of the weights on this occasion. Alissam emerged with credit despite pulling hard over 1m here last time and is also considered back in trip, with Celtic Motif taken to round out the 1-2-3.

  1. CITY HOUSE (IRE)
  2. ALISSAM (IRE)
  3. CELTIC MOTIF (IRE)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF (C & G) Maiden
races.verdict:
SELOSSE seemed unsuited by conditions at Naas and is well worth another chance now fitted with cheekpieces given the strength of his debut form. Warrior of Siam seems sure to benefit from the experience of his first run here a fortnight ago and is a big danger. Bridgetown Boy and the steadily progressive Golden Idol complete the shortlist.

  1. SELOSSE (IRE)
  2. WARRIOR OF SIAM (IRE)
  3. BRIDGETOWN BOY (FR)

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Maiden
races.verdict:
CASTILIAN QUEEN and Carafinn stand out on form, with Ger Lyons' filly preferred on the back of a well-advertised second here last time. Kathy M and Lochlane appeal most of the Joseph O'Brien contingent.

  1. CASTILIAN QUEEN
  2. CARAFINN (IRE)
  3. KATHY M (USA)

races.name: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict:
FLYING FORTRESS can notch a third success for the Gavin Cromwell yard. Soaring Sun is a big danger if settling, while Tero D'Rosa could be worth another chance.

  1. FLYING FORTRESS
  2. SOARING SUN (IRE)
  3. TERO D'ROSA (IRE)

races.name: Safer Gambling Week 2026 Handicap (0-60)
races.verdict:
YOUNG CHURCHILL was unlucky not to finish closer to Doctor Grace when that rival was successful here a week ago and he looks a sporting bet to reverse the form this time. Tintinabulla is also of interest, while Lisnadill requires a market check.

  1. YOUNG CHURCHILL (IRE)
  2. DOCTOR GRACE (IRE)
  3. TINTINABULLA (IRE)

races.name: Race 1 - BANI YAS (Group 2) Sponsored By Azizi Developments
Race 2 - Azizi Florence Fillies Maiden Stakes
races.verdict:
MISS TRICKSTER ran a promising race on debut and can go one better. Mukheefah looks best of the newcomers and can beat Coroneta to second place.

  1. MISS TRICKSTER (USA)
  2. MUKHEEFAH (USA)
  3. CORONETA (USA)

races.name: Race 3 - Azizi Venice (Benchmark 85 Handicap)
races.verdict:
ARIGATOU GOZAIMASU made a pleasing return and can go one better back on dirt. Donde Firmo is worth a look, while Smart System also has claims.

  1. ARIGATOU GOZAIMASU (USA)
  2. DONDE FIRMO (URU)
  3. SMART SYSTEM (USA)

races.name: Race 4 - Azizi Riviera Maiden Stakes
races.verdict:
MOODY GG sets a good standard and can open his account at the second time of asking. Desert Army is an interesting newcomer and can chase the selection home from Anahona.

  1. MOODY GG (USA)
  2. DESERT ARMY (USA)
  3. ANAHONA (USA)

races.name: Race 5 - Thunder Snow Handicap Sponsored By Azizi Developments
races.verdict:
The vote goes to ARLAN to make a winning return at the expense of old rival Killer Collect. Local Dynasty and Swing Vote are others to consider.

  1. ARLAN (USA)
  2. KILLER COLLECT (USA)
  3. LOCAL DYNASTY (IRE)

races.name: Race 6 - The Dubai Creek Mile Listed Stakes Sponsored By Azizi Developments
races.verdict:
MENDELSSOHN BAY made a successful return in this race last year and can repeat the feat. Heart of Honor could be the danger.

  1. MENDELSSOHN BAY (USA)
  2. HEART OF HONOR
  3. DIAMOND DEALER (USA)

races.name: Race 7 - Burj Azizi Handicap
races.verdict:
GUN CARRIAGE made a pleasing return here a fortnight ago and can build on that and gain a second career success. The unexposed Jabal Jais can make his presence felt on his handicap bow, while Nyaar also has solid claims.

  1. GUN CARRIAGE (USA)
  2. JABAL JAIS (USA)
  3. NYAAR (USA)

Prix De Fleurines Claiming Stakes - Awt
Prix Du Bois D'Enfer Handicap - Awt
Prix De L'Arbre A Fougeres Handicap - Awt
Prix De La Route De L'Arbre A Fougeres Handicap - Awt
